batch: 5: conditional (piecewise) Procrustes on real low-ceiling gaps
status_at_freeze: script written and syntax-checked only; not run on any data before this record; no result seen. Related earlier facts known to the authors at freeze: the spiral twist (twist.py) defeats global linear maps on synthetic data, and CCA on the real COCO/Laya gaps scores 0.15-0.36 (results/review/coco_gaps.json, laya_gaps.json).
gaps: 9 COCO image->text, 6 Laya image->text, ModernBERT base->fine-tuned (16 gaps)
criteria: R1: on at least one real gap the train-selected conditional map beats CCA(128-d PCA space) by >=0.02 P@1 with paired 95% bootstrap CI excluding 0. R2: report the number of gaps with max D>0. Controls: spiral a=1 must give selected-minus-CCA >=0.02 with CI>0; identity gap must give max D<=0.01; if a control fails R1 is inconclusive.
